create_augment_pipe: create an AugmentPipe instance with configurable xflip, rotate90, scale, brightness, contrast, hue, saturation, noise, and cutout augmentation probability multipliers
run_augment_pipe_forward: run the AugmentPipe forward pass on a batch of images to apply geometric, color, filtering, and corruption augmentations
build_transformation_matrix: build a 2D or 3D homogeneous transformation matrix using translate2d, scale2d, rotate2d, translate3d, scale3d, or rotate3d helper functions
review_wavelet_filters: review the wavelet dictionary containing haar, db1 through db8, and sym2 through sym8 low-pass filter coefficients for image-space filtering
refactor_augment_pipe_params: refactor the AugmentPipe class to adjust augmentation probability multipliers and standard deviation parameters for geometric, color, and corruption transforms
